title: REST API Basics
intro: REST API basics interview questions for Ruby freshers cover the HTTP and JSON fundamentals every junior Rails developer needs. This module covers REST principles (resources, representations, statelessness), HTTP verbs and their semantics (GET reads, POST creates, PUT/PATCH updates, DELETE removes), the status codes every developer must know (200 OK, 201 Created, 204 No Content, 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden, 404 Not Found, 422 Unprocessable Entity, 500 Server Error), JSON in Ruby (JSON.parse, JSON.generate, render json: in Rails), ActionController::API for API-only Rails apps, route namespacing for versioning, reading params from JSON body vs query string, why CSRF protection is disabled in API mode, and testing endpoints with Postman or curl. Every answer includes the practical example you would show in an interview.
